block.liveR.install.title: R is not installed on this device
block.liveR.install.body: Live R blocks run webR, R compiled to WebAssembly. Lumen doesn't include it: webR's binaries (R and libgfortran) are licensed under the GNU GPL version 3. Download it once ({size} MB, webR {version}) and it stays on this device and works offline.
block.liveR.install.source: From webR's own site, webr.r-wasm.org (or the npm package webr@{version} on cdn.jsdelivr.net if that fails). Every file is checked against this build's checksums. Nothing from your notes is sent.
block.liveR.install.error.mismatch: A downloaded file did not match this build's checksum, so nothing was installed: {detail}
block.liveR.install.error.noCache: R can only be stored once Lumen's offline support is active. Reload the page, then try again.
block.liveR.install.error.noManifest: This build can't download R (it has no webR manifest).
